tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam pa'i chos dran pa nyer bzhag pa'i mdo yi don snang bar byed pa'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// shes bya'i gnas lugs gsal ba'i 'od 'phro ba// gti mug mun pa'i tshang tshing rab tu sel// rgyal dbang nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag tu lta ba'i mun pa rab sel cing*// 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab rab tu skems byed pa// dam chos dran pa nye bzhag 'od zer ni// spro bar bya phyir bstan bcos 'di brtsam mo// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal po'i khab tu bzhugs pa na// sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas// mdo 'di rab tu gsal bar mdzad// khams gsum rab tu 'khor ba yi// 'gro 'di sems nyid ma rtogs pas// don dang sems can bdag rnam rig /snang ba'i rnam par shes pa ni// yang dag ma yin kun rtog las// byung ste gzung dang 'dzin pa ni// med bzhin bdag dang gzhan du 'khrul// 'di ni srid pa'i rtsa ba yin// don 'di gsal bar byed pa gang*// chos dang chos min tshul bzhin du// thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab kyis// mos bya rtogs bya mngon du bya// de la thog mar dran pa yis// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// rgyu dang 'bras bu rab ldan pa// brtag bya zag bcas zag med nyid// 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med ni// nyon mongs zag pa rags pa dang*// rags pa bcom dang bag la nyal// bsam gtan bcas pa go rim bzhin// zag med 'jig rten 'das pa yi// thabs dang shes rab kyis zin pa'o// thog mar dge dang mi dge yi// tshul la rab tu brtag par bya// srog gcod ma byin len pa dang*// 'dod log lus kyi las gsum ste// brdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang*// ngag kyal zhes bya ngag la bzhi// brnab sems gnod sems log par blta// yid kyi gsum mo mi dge bcu// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi// bskyed pa'i las ni bsdus pa yin// rgyu dang ngo bo dbye ba dang*// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi shes bya// rgyu ni thog med bag chags kyi// 'du byed las rnams bsags pa can// bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin pa yi// rkyen gyis nyon mongs bdag nyid do// srog gcod pa yi ngo bo ni// mtshon cha dug dang sngags sogs kyis// srog gi dbang po phral ba'o// de yi dbye ba rnam pa dgu// pha ma dgra bcom bsod chen po// lam gnas gsod pas 'bring po ste// dud 'gro gsod sogs chung ba yin// byas zin byas dang byed 'gyur gyi// dus kyi dbye ba rnam pa gsum// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi

/nyon mongs rkyen byas rnam pa gsum// phan par 'dod pas sman byin dang*// lam zhugs me 'bar phan sems kyis// bdegs dang mi 'dod mtshon lhung ba// de dag rnams ni sdig mi 'gyur// ma byin len pa'i ngo bo ni// pha rol bdag gir byas pa'i rdzas// rku ba'i sems kyis blangs pa'o// dngos dang thabs kyis len pa dang*// ma mthong len pa rnam pa gsum// gzhan ni srog gcod skabs bzhin no// 'dod pas log par g.yems pa ni// bdag gam gzhan gyi chung ma la// gnas ma yin par spyod pa'o// tshul ldan phal pa phyogs mthun bcas// dbye ba rnam pa gsum du brjod// nyon mongs dbye ba ci rigs sbyar// brdzun ni bdag gzhan slu byed pa'i// ngag gi rnam pa brjod pa'o// bla ma'i brdzun dang phal pa dang*// zhar las brjod pa gsum du brjod// phra ma mthun pa 'byed pa'i ngag /yul dang bsam pa sbyor ba yi// dbye ba rnam gsum bdag nyid can// tshig rtsub bdag gzhan gdung ba yi// ngag ste dbye ba snga ma bzhin// 'khyal ba'i tshig ni 'brel med du// brjod pa'o yul dang bsam sbyor gyi// nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs chung*// bdun po 'di rnams sbyor ba dang*// dngos rjes rdzogs pa lci ba ste// gnyis 'bring gcig ni 'bras bu yang*// brnab sems gzhan gyi phun tshogs la// gdung par byed pa chags pas bskyed// gnod sems gzhan la gdung ba yi// bsam pa zhe sdang gis bskyed pa// bdag dang gang zag lta ba dang*// rgyu med rgyu 'bras khyad gsod pa// log par lta ba zhes brjod de// gti mug ldan pa ma rig pa// chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba yis// yul dus rnams la ci rigs sbyar// byas dang byed du bcug pa dang*// yid rang dbye ba kun la brjod// rnam pa'i dbye ba dpag tu med// 'bras bu byed pa rgyu mthun ni// gang gang byas pa byed 'dod pa'o// myong ba rgyu mthun rnam smin gyis// 'bras bu rgya cher bshad pa ni// rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs las 'byung*// dbang 'bras phyi rol la snang ste// gang gi stobs kyis gang skyes pa// 'bras de skyes bu'i byed las skyes// bral 'bras zhes bya de zad pa'o// rgyu rnams spyod cing yongs rdzogs pa// nges par spyod 'gyur las yin no// spyod kyang de la mi dga' dang*// ma rdzogs gnyen pos bcom pa gang*// byas kyang myong 'gyur min zhes brjod// dngos su spyod pa ma yin kyang*// 'dun dang smon cing yid rang bar// byed pa ma byas myong 'gyur las// sgyu ma byas shing mi myong pa// zhes bya mu ni rnam pa bzhi// mi dge rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas// de las bzlog pa dge bcu ste// 'dun dang rang bzhin spyod pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa'i khyad par gyis// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// bdag nyid byed dang gzhan dag 'god// yid rang byed pas bla na med// 'bras bu tshe ring nad med dang*// phun sum tshogs la dbang byed dang*// bud med 'gran zla med thob cing*// kun gyis bden pa'i bsngags pa thob// mi phyed pa yi 'khor thob cing*// gnyan cing bden pas kun du smra// don dang ldan pa'i tshig thob dang*// bdag nyid 'byor la gnod gzhan med// gdug zla med cing kun gyis mchod// yang dag lta ba mchog thob pa// so so'i rnam smin 'bras bu yin// rgyu mthun la sogs sngar bzhin brjod// 'dod pa'i phun sum tshogs bde ba// chung ngus chung la 'bring gis 'bring*// chen pos 'khor lo sgyur ba dang*// brgya byin 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'thob// rgyal ba kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i// tshul khrims zag med lhan cig pas// theg gsum 'bras bu thob par 'gyur// de ltar dge dang mi dge ba// 'dod pa'i khams las ma 'das phyir// blo ldan 'dod las nges 'byung phyir// ma chags sbyin la brtson byas nas// tshul khrims la brten bag yod par// dben par bsam gtan 'jig rten pa// 'thob byed thabs la sems par byed// de yang yul drug snang ba dang*// dbang po drug dang rnam shes kyi// khyad par rtog cing spyod pa na// bde dang sdug bsngal btang snyoms kyi// rtog pa bco brgyad mthong 'gyur na// sa gzhan la yang 'jug par 'gyur// de nas tshor ba thabs cad kyi// gnas la mngon bar rtog par byed// sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang*// rnam par shes dang drug khams po// phyi dang nang du snang ba dang*// byed po med la rang gi yang*// mtshan nyid 'dzin par byed mthong nas// kye ma 'gro 'di tshor ba ni// bde la chags shing sdug bsngal la// zhe sdang btang snyoms ma rig pas// kun du 'ching bar byed par 'gyur// yang ni sa gzhan rim 'jug 'gyur// reg pa'i rkyen gyi tshor ba ste// tshor ba rtag min bden pa min// btang snyoms la brten rtog pa dag

/rab tu sbyangs nas bsam gtan dang*// gzugs med bzhir bcas rab tu rtog /de yis khams gsum sred len dang*// srid pa mngon du rtogs par byed// der gnas skye mched bcu gnyis dang*// phung po lnga po snang ba kun// 'du byed rkyen gyis rnam par shes// 'du shes tshor ba rab snang ba// skad cig skye 'gag byed mthong 'gyur// de ltar ming gzugs bcas pa 'di// ma rig rkyen gyis 'du byed ces// khams gsum pa kun mthong gyur nas// de la brten nas 'dus byas kyi// las kun mngon du rtogs 'gyur te// kun gzhi rkyen gyi rnam shes te// yid ni nye bar spyod pa can// de las nyer spyod tshor ba ste// yongs gcod 'du shes nyid yin no// rnam shes 'jug pa'i rkyen byed gang*// 'du byed sems 'byung bcas pa yin// kun gzhi la gnas ma rig pas// yang dag mthong la sgrib par byed// 'du byed las kyi bag chags rnams// 'jog byed de bzhin rnam shes kyis// khams gsum skye ba'i gnas phyin byed// ming gzugs 'brel pas lus 'dzin no// skye mched drug gis rdzogs byed de// gsum 'dus gcod pa reg pa'o// tshor bas nye bar spyod byed la// srid pa'i sred pas sdud par byed// len pas skye ba sbyor ba ste// mngon du las kyi rnam smin rnams// nye bar bsgrub byed shes pa yin// de ltar las chos rnam par smin// rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa ni// khams gsum sems dang sems 'byung kun// dper na ri mo mkhan bzhin du// khams gsum snang ba'i bri gzhi la// sems nyid ri mo mkhan gyis ni// 'dod la dmigs shing nyer len pas// 'dod khams gzugs ni nyi shu 'bri// gzugs khams la dmigs bsam gtan bzhis// bcu gnyis 'bri'o rnam lnga gzhan// de bral snyoms 'jug bzhi yi ni// sred pas gzugs med sgrub pa yin// lus snang tshon rtsi'i snod bzhin te// yul ni lnga po tshon rtsi bzhin// 'du byed brtson 'grus lag pa yis// dbang po drug gis pir bzung ste// dkar po dge ba'i tshon gyi ni// lha gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'bri// dmar po chags bcas lha mi yi// gzugs 'bri ser pos dud 'gro ste// sngon pos yi dwags 'bri byed cing*// nag pos dmyal ba'i gzugs 'bri'o// gzhan yang sems nyid ri mo mkhan// mnyes pas mtho ris 'bri byed de// ma mgu khros pas ngan song la// bar mas 'dres ma 'bri ba yin// dge dang mi dge dag gi las// rang gis byas pa'i las kun gyi// 'bras bu nges par spyod 'gyur te// lus can rnams dang 'brel ba yin// nyon mongs sa ni dang por mngar// rnam par smin pa tsha ba yin// de dag don med byed pas na// dug dang 'dra bar spang bar bya// nyon mongs dbang du mi 'gro zhing*// ye shes dbang du 'gro bya ste// ye shes ldan pa tshe 'di dang*// pha rol dag tu bde ba 'thob// dran ba nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las// rgyu 'bras kyi mdor bstan pa ste dang po'o//

༈ //khams gsum srid pa'i 'khor lo ni// rgyud lnga dag tu rab tu 'khor// de la dmyal ba tsha dang grang*// nye tshe zhes bya rnam pa gsum// tsha ba yang sos thig nag dang*// bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod ngu 'bod che// tsha dang rab tu tsha ba dang*// mnar med ces bya brgyad du bshad// kun la lhag pa'i 'khor bcu drug /mi dge chen por spyad pa'i rgyus// sred pas bslus nas rab tu skye// de dag rnam par bshad par bya// yang sos gtso bor skye ba'i rgyu// srog gcod nyid do tshul ldan mi// gsod cing 'gyod par mi byed na// sdug bsngal ma lus myong bar 'gyur// mi gtsang 'dam dang lcags kyi rgyur// snod btso gnod pa ma zhi dang*// mun pa kun du mi dga' ba// tshor ba 'bod dang nad thams cad// mtshon 'bab gnod pa drag po dang*// ne le nag 'dra gzhan gyur dang*// sdug bsngal gyis gnod pad ma'i phreng// mtshe'u dang gnod pa mtho ba ste /yang sos 'khor ni bcu drug yin// de dag so sor 'gro ba'i rgyu// bya khra brgya dang gdos sogs kyis// srog chags gsod par byed pa dang*// nyo tshong phyir ni dud 'gro gsod// zas phyir sreg dang 'tshod pa dang*// 'ching dang brdeg pa la sogs pa// gnod pa du mas gsod par byed// ru sbal phyugs dag mun par 'jug /rnga sgra sogs sgrags gsod pa dang*// gnod pas tshor ba du ma byed// dug sbyin shan pa byed pa dang*// dmag dpon byed dang gzhan gnod byed// thabs kyis gsod dang sngags kyis gsod// mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor de bzhin bcu// gsod par byed pa sgrub pa'o// yang sos gnas ni lcags kyi ra ba du ma du// mtshon cha'i nags tshal ro nye mi gtsang 'bab chu lhan// der skyes phan tshun gsod pa'i sems dang rab ldan pas// gtubs gshegs mi bzad sdug bsngal myong nas yang sos 'gyur// mi gtsang 'dam du srin bus za zhing gnyen pos gsod// lcags kyi ra bar mtshon cha'i char gyi rab tu btub// lcags kyi rdza chen me 'bar nang du 'tshod par byed// la la gnod pa du mas 'tshe zhing gzhan dag ni// mun nag nang du me 'bar ri yis kun du btsir// rab 'jigs sgra sgrogs sems can dag gis za bar byed// ba tsha me dang mtshon gyi tshor ba du mas nyen// nad rnams kyis nyen gzhan dag mtshon chas rab tu dmyal// gshin rje rnams kyi gnod pa du mas bsnun par byed// ne'u le nag ltar me 'bar lus la dud pas khyab// bkres pas gzhan gyur sdug bsngal du mas rnam par gtses// pad ma ltar gas lus kun kha dang bya rgod za// zangs zhun mtshe'ur rab lhung cho nge rab tu 'debs// mtshon cha'i lam du sha dang rus pa dum bur byed// de sogs sdug bsngal du ma rab tu 'khrug par myong*// mtshon gyi reg sogs mi yi lus las bcu 'gyur yin// de las thar kyang tshe thung nad rnams kyi gtses nas// srog dang bral byed mi khom gzhan dang mtshungs par 'gyur// de ltar de dag rnams kyi tshe// rang gi lo ni lnga brgya ste// mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum dang*// drug khri nyis stong rnams yin no// rgyu ni rdzogs dang ma rdzogs pas// dus min 'chi ba yod pa'o// de nas gnyis pa thig nag ni// srog gcod ma byin len pa gnyis// spyad la byung ste gtso bo ni// srog gcod rgyu 'bras snga ma bzhin// khyad par ma byin len pa ni// dkon mchog bla ma dge 'dun dang*// nad pa sdug 'phongs rnams kyi rdzas// rku zhing gzhan yang sbyor byed na// sdug bsngal ma lus myong par byed// de 'khor ro myags phyi sa'i 'dam// ral gri tshal dang shal ma li// chu rlung rab med spu gri'i tshal// rmongs dang rab tu rmongs pa'i tshal// sred pa can dang sred pas nyen// zangs khu 'thung dang thu lum za// sreg pa mi bzad mun pa can// rab tu mi bzad bya rgod 'jigs// de rnams rgyu ni sred dbang gis// dad ldan longs spyod 'phrog byed dang*// dge 'dun longs spyod bdag gir byed// nor kun 'phrog dang bu smad phyir// kun du sred pas rku bar byed// chu 'gram 'joms dang nor phyir bsnun// thabs kyis rku dang sdigs shing 'phrog

/zhe sdang gis 'phrog bdag gis byed// bza' btung kho na'i phyir len dang*// lta ngan ston cing des tshim byed// mun khrod ma byin len pa dang*// bag med dkor la bdag gir byed// rgyal khams don phyir bkres skom gyis// mi rnams nyen byas gang yin pa'o// thig nag gnas na lcags kyi sa gzhi me 'bar steng*// las kyi gshed po rab 'jigs rnams kyis thig btab nas// shing mkhan lta bur sog le me 'bar gyis 'dral zhing*// sta res bzhog cing gsor gyi 'bugs la tho bas brdung*// skrag nas bros pas ro nye'i nang lhung rul cing myags// phyi sa'i 'dam du mar ko ta yis 'bugs shing za// la la ral gri'i tshal du rgyug pas lus kun btubs// shal ma ri la sred pas yan lag sha rgyus gcod// nor dang zas mthong rgyugs pas chu bo rab med du// lhung nas lus myags dbang med kye ma kyi hud 'bod// spu gris lus la char ltar babs nas yi blong byed// lcags leb me 'bar lus la dkris nas dran pa nyams// gshed pos sdigs shing dum bur byas kyang 'chi mi 'gyur// me 'bar phur pas lus brgyangs mtshon chas gnad kun gcod// ma rungs khyi rnams kyis bzung cham chom za ba dang*// thu lum zangs khu 'bar ba khar blugs nang khrol bsreg /thag pas bcings nas me 'bar mtshon cha'i tshal du lhung*// mun nag thibs po du ba ku bar 'jug par byed// me 'bar mal du ro nye 'thung dang dbang po rnams// ma lus 'byin dang de bzhin gshed pos sdug bsngal ba'i// chad pa du ma myong 'gyur 'di ni bzod pa med// yang sos sdug bsngal bcu 'gyur las kyang lhag par 'gyur// de las thar kyang yi dwags 'jig rten rab skye zhing*// mir skyes na yang longs spyod med cing nor nyams 'gyur// 'di dag rang lo stong thub ste// mi lo bye ba 'bum phrag ni// bcu gnyis dang yang bye ba phrag /dgu khri drug stong nyid yin no// rgyu bzhin sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te// longs spyod sred pas bslus pa yin// bsdus 'joms nyid du skye ba'i rgyu// lus kyi las gsum rdzogs pa ste// khyad par 'dod log las byung ba// tshul khrims 'jig spyod gtso bo ste// de 'khor tshor ba tshad med dang*// 'bras bu a la pud ltar gcod// gnad nas gnad gcod chen po dang*// 'khums pa dang ni 'jigs par blta// nyam nga gnod pa mi bzod pa// a tsha kyi hud mchi rgyun can// tshor ba mtha' med zhes bya dang*// dbang po 'gags dang pad ltar gas// pad ma che dang me thab dang*// ra ba mthong ste bcu drug go

/der ni gshin rje'i tshogs kyis rab tu gtses byas pas// lhan cig 'du tshe lcags kyi dra bas steng nas g.yogs// tho ba mtshon cha'i char pas dmyal cing brdung bar byed// khyad par 'dod log rgyu yi shal ma li la ni// las kyis byas pa'i bud med mthong nas der 'dzegs pas// lus kun btubs shing sdug bsngal du ma myong bar 'gyur// der ni 'gro bar byed pa'i rgyu// 'os min bud med la g.yem dang*// kha dang mi 'dod gzhan du byed// byis pa ngu bar byed pa dang*// phyugs kyi mngal dang skyes pa gzhan// sde gzhan thob nas gzhan byed dang*// dud 'gro gzhan dang ma sring dang*// tshul 'chal lhan cig spyod pa dang*// bud med dran pas 'dod sems skyed// gnas gzhan 'dod la yid dbang 'gro// 'dod la dmigs te tshangs spyod dang*// sngon gyi 'dod la yongs su gdung*// sna tshogs g.yeng bas 'dod pa ste// rgyu ni bcu drug de rnams so// gzhan dag gsal shing me 'bar ro smad 'bigs par byed// khar ni phur bus brdung dang lcags leb 'bar ba dkris// sdug pa'i bu ltar snang bas sems la gdung bar byed// zangs khu 'bar bas lus kyi smad rnams sreg par 'gyur// las kyis dud 'gro'i khong pa me 'bar nang du gnas// me 'bar 'jigs pa'i gshin rjes bzung nas sdug bsngal myong*// dbang po'i sgo kun bsreg cing gcan ga zan rnams kyis za// a tsa srin bus g.yengs shing sha rul bzhin du 'gyur// lcags ri 'bar ba las kyis khwa rnams kyi gtor cing*// phyi nang med par rab bsreg tshor ba du mas nyen// dbang po'i sgo kun zangs khu sa dang srin bus gang*// zangs kyi snod bcug gtun shing 'bar bas rab tu gzir// pad ma 'dra ba'i me 'bar nang bcug kun du dmyal// lus la me lce gcig gyur lcags kyi ra ba 'bar// me dang mtshon cha'i char kyis rab bsregs sdug bsngal myong*// de las thar kyang ma ning rigs nyams rnams su 'gyur// de ltar 'di dag rnams kyi tshe// rang gi lo ni nyis stong ste// mi lo phye ba phrag bye ba// gcig dang bye ba sum 'bum dang*// drug khri brgyad stong rnams yin no// so so las kyi mthu bzhin du// bar ma dor ni 'pho ba yod// des na 'bad pa du ma yis// lus kyi las rnams spang bar bya// de las gzhan yang ngu 'bod kyi// rgyu ni lus kyi las gsum dang*// chang 'thung pa las byung pa ste// ngu 'bod gtso bor skye ba'i rgyu// chang gi sbyor ba brtson byed cing*// tshul ldan mkhas pa bsam gtan pa// chang gis myos par byed pas na// de ni mi dge gtso bo yin// de 'khor sgra chen sgra 'byin dang*// skra la me 'bar me srin bu// lcags kyi me 'bar gtun shing dang*// rdo me char ltar 'bab pa dang*// 'chi med lcags tshal dgon pa dang*// de bzhin rab rib kun stsags dang*// gshin rje'i 'tshams dgon shal ma'i tshal// shal ma'i tshal chen dud pa'i tshal// me mdag dud pa'i 'dres pa'i tshal// klog gi na bun kun rtog ste// de ltar 'khor ni bcu drug tu// skye ba'i rgyu ni myos byed 'chang*// gso sbyong blangs la dud pa dang*// sdom pa blangs la dang por blud// dge bsnyen chang 'thung la sbyar dang*// chang 'tshong gzhan dag slu byed pa// bya dang dud 'gro gsod phyir blud// glang chen sbad phyir blud pa dang*// bud med bslu dang dug sbyar chang*// dgra la ldud dang rin sbyin dang*// chang phyir gos sogs de bzhin ster// bcom phyir sna tshogs chang byed pa// rmongs phyir bslu dang bud med rnams// myos par bya phyir chang ster ba// chom kun srog dang phral phyir dang*// thabs kyi bslus phyir blud pa dang*// rngon pa la sogs mgyogs phyir blud// rgyu ni bcu drug brjod pa yin// ngu 'bod ces bya gnas der lcags kyi sa gzhi la// gshin rje'i skyes bus zangs khu skol ba khar blugs nas// ngu ba'i sgra 'byin nang khrol sreg cing dud pa 'thul// lkog mar lhag lhag sgra 'byin snod po gzhan yang 'byung*// lcags zhun 'bar bas tshig nas khros pas slar yang ldud// gtun shing gis brdegs sgra cher ngu yang slar la brdeg

/me'i char bab skra dang lus kun rtsa bzhin bsreg /nad kun 'khrug cing srin bus lus kun lcig lcig za// yan lag me 'bar mtshon chas dum bur byed pa dang*// me yi glang gis 'joms shing rdo rje char ltar 'bab// 'bar ba'i khyi yis 'bras bu 'byin cing sha rus gtor// 'khor los bsnun cing yan lag mtshon gyis gcod par byed// phyogs kun mun pas khyab cing gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung*// gshed pos yan lag sha rgyus bcad cing gshog par byed// ro nye'i chu bor 'tshod cing mtshon cha'i tshal gyis 'bigs// shal ma li la 'jigs pas spu gris kun du btubs// me 'bar dud pa drag por 'gre ldog rab tu rmongs// me mdag yin// de rnams rgyu 'bras lhan cig bshad// ngu 'bod gtsor ni sngar brjod dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun// 'byung la khyad par rdzun gyi 'bras bu rab tsha ba// lcags kyi sa gzhi rab 'bar gzhi la de'i lce// dum bur byed// chags shing zhen pas gzhan dag kyang*// brdzun du smra la sbyong byed gang*// de la me dang ba tsha dug /mtshon sogs tshor ba dpag med 'byung*// phyi rol zhing sogs 'phrog pa'i rdzun// smra ba de ni gshin rje yis// 'bar ba bcug cing tho ba yis// rab tu brdung yang tshe mi 'pho// mi tshangs spyod cing ma byas zhes// brdzun smra de ni gshin rje yis// spyi bor phug cing lce drangs nas// rnam pa brgyar yang btub par byed// nor rnams 'phrog phyir brdzun smra na// me dang srin bu rnams kyis gnod// dge 'dun nor la slu ba gang*// nang khrol btol cing mtshon chas brdeg /chom kun dge sbyong ltar bcos nas// tshong pa slu ba'i brdzun smra na// tho bas bcom nas slar yang 'tsho// u dpal 'dra ba'i mes sreg 'gyur// bden bcos brdzun du smra byed gang*// kun nas rgyug pas phyogs su 'bros// phur bu gcan gzan rnams kyis gnod// phyis kyis bsam pa 'grub mi 'gyur// nad bcas nyams thag slu ba gang*// bza' btung gnas kyi 'du shes kyis// ro nye me 'bar lus kun 'tshod// srid gzhan gso sman med par 'gyur// bzo dang nor phyir brdzun byed gang*// sbrul chen seng ge rnams kyis gnod// stobs 'gyed nyes pas rdzun byas nas// lcags leb 'bar dkris sdug bsngal myong*// khas blangs 'gal ba'i brdzun byed pa// 'bar ba'i khab kyi lus kun 'bigs// ded dpon bcas pa 'joms byed par// log par khrid pas tshad med pa// chu srin srin bu du mas za// dge 'dun na ba'i gso sman rnams// sbyin zhes smra /drug bcu drug dang sa ya gsum// lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong yin/ ༈ /tsha ba'i dmyal bar skye byed pa'i// rgyu ni sngar bshad las kun dang*// khyad par log par lta ba yis// rgyu 'bras las la skur 'debs pa'o// de 'khor rab tu sreg pa che// pad dkar sbrul 'khyil lta bu dang*// zangs bzhus nya 'khyug lcags bum pa// chu dmar rkang srin thams cad sreg /sar bying mtha' yas pad chen 'dra// mtha' drag rus pa 'byung zhing 'du// lcags kyi skud pas 'dral zhing gcod// srin bu 'khod do mes 'jigs bskyed// nags me 'khrigs dang bung bas gnod// de ltar bcu drug gsungs pa yin// 'dir ni snga ma'i dmyal ba kun las rab drag pa'i// las kyis 'chi khar 'khrul snang gnad gcod sdug bsngal che// me lces sreg cing nad rnams thams cad dus cig smin// ngu 'bod sdug bsngal thams cad bcu 'gyur dag tu 'byung*// 'di yi sdug bsngal dper bya rung ba ma yin te// log lta drag pos 'phangs phyir tsha la drag pa yin// gang zhig lhar ni skye ba'i rgyu// srog gcod yin zhes smra ba gang*// sreg byed 'bar ba'i me de ni// bcu drug 'gyur gyis thal bar rlog /zas bcad mtho ris thob ston na// pad dkar 'dra ba'i tshal du sreg /chang 'thung lhag dang tsog pu yi// thar ston zhi ba smod byed pa// de ni sbrul chen 'bar ba yis// rab sreg bkres pas nyams thag 'gyur// las med dbang phyug rgyur smra na// zang zhun nang skyes nya 'dras za// gsod pa'i mchod sbyin byed pa gang*// bum pa ro nye spu gri yis// gang bar bsreg cing dum bur byed// tshul nyams log pa'i bka' thub byed// de ni gshed pos mtshon chas brdeg /ro nye'i chur lhung ngu sgra 'byin// log lta srin bu gnod pa dang*// me lnga brten pas grol smra ba// de ni 'khor lo ri dang me// srin bu rnams kyi rkang bam 'drul// nags sreg me la mchod byed pa// gnyen bcas sreg mthong ngu sgra 'byin// srog chags bsregs pas bde smra gang*// mdag mar gshin rje rnams kyis sreg

dug 'dra sbyar ba'i mchod sbyin byed// pad ma 'drar 'tshed tsher mas 'bugs// chur 'chi'i brtul shugs spyod byed gang*// 'bar ba'i rig 'dzeg ro nyer ltung*// rgyu med smra zhing 'dod rgyal spyod// rus pas lus phugs gshin rje dmyal// log pa'i mtshan dmigs grol smra ba// lcags kyi skud pas dum bur byed// bdag dang 'jig rten rtag smra ba// de la mtshon cha srin bu me// rab 'bar sreg byed mkhun sgra 'byin// rtag dang mi rtag mthar 'dzin smra// de ni mun pa 'dra ba'i mer// 'thor cing rlung drag sdug bsngal 'byung*// 'khor ba'i thog ma gang smra ba// bung ba rnams dang gshin rje yis// sha kun ba spu tsam du byed// 'di rnams la thar yi dwags dang*// dud 'gro de dang de 'drar skye// mir skyes rgyu mthun de mtshungs 'gyur// 'dir ni rang lo khri drug stong*// mi lo bye ba'ang bye ba phra// lnga brgya dang ni sum cu dang*// sa ya brgyad dang bzhi 'bum dang*// khri dang drug stong du 'gyur ro// rab tu tsha ba chen po ru// skye ba'i rgyu ni lus ngag gi /las bdun log ltar bcas pa'o// khyad par dge slong ma rnam dag /lta log mi dger 'jug byed pa// des ni gtso bo'i sdug bsngal myong*// de 'khor phyogs kun bsreg pa dang// lus chen sgra 'byin me spyi gtsug /me mdag 'bab dang mdag ma can// a la thams cad sdug bsngal dang*// rab tsha rtag tu mun pas khebs// gnod rgyud srad pus rgyud dkrugs dang*// skra shad 'dzing dang snying rje'i sgra /snying rje che rung snying rje med// shing skam bsdus 'dra bcu drug go /'dir skyes sdug bsngal dpag med de// khams bzhi 'khrugs pas gdung byed cing*// bar dor sdug bsngal kyi hud 'byin// gnas der dpag tshad stong phrag du ma 'khrugs pa'i mes// spyi tshugs bsregs nas bye ma gtor bzhin zhig par 'gyur// skam pas 'dren dang lce la thong gshol 'bar bas smod// gshin rjes gnod cing zang khu 'thung la bya khyis gtor// shal ma rir 'dzeg mar ko ta yi lus kun bshigs// sngar bshad dmyal ba kun la sdug bsngal bcu 'gyur yin// dge bsnyen log ltar nyams byed gang*// 'bar bsregs thag pas 'ching par

bus 'bugs par byed// me dang mun pa gcan gzan dang*// gshin rje rnams kyi snang ba yis// rmongs nas sgra 'byin dbang po 'gyur// gshang ci 'byin sogs rtags rnams 'byung*// de yi lus la dmyal ba'i mes// /dbang med der ni 'tshod par byed// de yi sgra thos dmyal ba gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun// brjed cing bde bar smon pa bzhin du 'gyur ba yin// de ni me mtshon dug dang rdo rje 'bar ba dang*// seng ge glang chen bse kyi bya rgod kang kha dang*// sbul chen khyi dang mar ko ta sogs du mas gang*// gshed pos gnod dang sdug bsngal dpag med kyis gzir nas// a la la zhes sgra chen bar 'tshams med par sgrog /tshor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jig rten dpe byar rung ba med// de sogs mi dge so so yis// 'bras bu myong ba dpag med pa// su zhig gis ni brjod par nus// de lus gzhon sha can la ni// dpag tshad cig nas lnga yi bar// 'grub te mnar med myong byed do// de 'khor bya rog khwa dang ni// sa 'og tshor ba mtha' med dang*// wa skad 'byin dang lce spyang zad// lto nag lus zhum sgra 'jigs ston// me tog zlum 'dra ri brtsegs 'bab// chu sgra skar 'phreng sdug bsngal nyen// gos dri lcags kyi glegs ma dang*// 'gro ba mes bsregs dang bcu drug /ma la ngan sems bskyed pa dang*// ba tsha 'bar bas nang khrol sreg /dgra bcom ma la log byed na// lcags 'bar dong du rab bcug ste// mtshon gnon tshogs kyis dum bur byed// ma la log par g.yem byed pa// 'bar ba'i phur bus lus kun 'joms// rang rgyal dgra bcom smod byed gang*// spu gris lce gcod rmon pas rmo// gtsug lag khang la mes bsregs na// de lus 'bar bas rab 'tshed nas// rdo me char ltar 'bab par 'gyur// 'dzem med sangs rgyas dkor spyod gang*// rang nyid bkres pas rang sha za// sbrul nag rab 'bar gyis 'joms byed// chos nor bab col nyams byas pas// 'bar ba'i shing gnyis kyis 'thag cing*// bya yis lus kun za bar byed// dge 'dun dkor 'joms gnod byas pas// lcags gtun 'bar bas brdung par byed// nad pa'i longs spyod 'phrog byed gang// nad rnams kyis gdung 'bar bar bsreg

༈ //de las gzhan yang dud 'gro yi// rnam pa sems kyi rab bsgrub pa// phal cher mi dges bskyed pa dang*// 'dres ma dge ba gang byas pa// gti mug shas cher gyur pa ni// bye ba sum cu rtsa bzhi yod// ༈ //de nas gzhan yang dge ba yi// rgyu las grub pa mi rnams ni// mchog ni 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*// skal pa dang po sgra mi gnyan// gling gnyis bar ma 'bring yin te// tha ma tshe lo bcu pa'o// de rnams gnas ni gling bcu gnyis// gling gsum longs spyod ldan pa ste// 'dzam gling las kyi sa par grags// khru brgyad bcu drug sum cu gnyis// shar nub byang gi lus kyi tshad// tshe ni brgya phrag phye dang gsum// shar yin nub byang phyed 'phags so// 'dir ni dpag med nas lo bcu// lus kyang de bzhin mtshungs gyur te// phyed dang bzhi dang khru bzhir grags// longs spyod thog mar gzugs khams bzhin// rim gyis sa zhag myu gu'i tshal// sa lu rnams kyi ro la chags// sred pas nyon mongs rab skyes nas// rtsod dang chags gyur mi dge spyad// mang pos bkur sogs rgyal rigs byung*// 'dod nyung nags gnas bram zer grags// bar ma rje rigs tha ma rmangs// mthar ni mi dge rdzogs byed pas// mu ge nad dang mtshon skal pa// lo zla zhag bdun go rim bzhin// de rnams ngan 'gror mtshungs pa yin// gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can// gling bzhi nas ni gcig gi bar// dbang byed 'khor lo nor bu dang*// glang rta bud med blon po dang*// dmag dpon bdun ste nye ba yang*// ral gri lpags pa khyim dang ni// tshal dang gos lham mal cha bdun// sbyin dang tshul khrims mthu las grub// bde sdug dge dang mi dge ba'i// rnam smin gyis bskyed dbang 'bras ni// yul snang thun mong thun mong min// gang gi stobs byas skyes bus byas// de bzhin so sor nyams su long*// skye rga na dang 'chi ba yis// rtag tu sdug bsngal gnod par byed// drag po 'od dkar khrung khrung dang*// zla ba lha min mi 'am ci// gsungs pa gling ni du ma rnams// sna tshogs las kyis bskyed pa'o// thams cad sems kyis bzos pa'o// ma rtogs 'khor bar rab tu 'khor// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las// mi yi le'u ste lnga pa'o//

༈ //de nas dge ba'i las spyod pas// grub pa lha ni rnam pa gsum// 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med do// 'dod pa drug ste de rnams ni// tshul khrims rnam pa bdun 'bras bu// dman dang 'bring dang gya nom las// bde ba chung 'bring chen po grub// de gnas gnyis ni ri rab brten// bzhi ni sprin spung lta bur gnas// ri rab gser gyi sa gzhi nas// 'bum dang drug khri brgyad stong ste// phyed ni lha min sngar brtan bzhin// steng du bang rim bzhi pa ste// rin chen bzhi las grub pa yin// ri bo khri phrag drug bcus mdzes// phyi rol ri bo gnya' shing 'dzin// lhun po'i phyed 'phags gshol mda' 'dzin// seng ldeng can dang lta na sdug /lta na rnam 'dud mu khyud ri// phyed phyed gyis dma' bar na 'tsho// dang po stong phrag brgyad cu ste// rol mtsho gzhan ni phyed phyed bri// de la rgyal chen bzhi rnams kyi// gnas gzhan bzhi la bcu bcu ste// phreng thogs yol thogs rtag myos dang*// pi wang gsum pa rim ci bzhin// srog gcod spang zhing sbyin ldan pa'i// las bskyed rim pas gsal brjod bya// dang po sa yi char gnas pa// 'di yi phyogs lta zur gnas zhes// gzhan dag g.yas skor rim pas gnas// gang zhig 'chi tshe dad ldan pas// skyabs so 'dir ni nges par skye// mtha' la gnas der skye ba'i rgyu// tshul ldan gru zam byin las gyur// 'bras bu nyer 'tsho'i gnas su ni// brtse bas 'bras bu sbyin pas skye// yon tan dkar po spyod pa ru// me tog mchod rten la phul skye// thams cad dgar gnas der skye ba// tshul ldan rgyal la me tog mchod// nags tshul mched pas nyen pa rnams// thar byed 'gro mgyogs gnas su skye// tshul ldan ga zhan dag sdum byed pa// yul la chags pa'i lha gnas skye// 'dod la chags pa'i gnas skye ba// dad pas chos mnyan rgyu las byung*// yid g.yo'i gnas der dkon mchog la// gus pas phyags dar byas pas skye// chos gos phyir ni cung zad phul// nye ba'i tshal kyi gnas su 'gro// de rnams las kyis bde spyod pa// 'khor lo bsgyur bas dpe bya min// de na rin chen sna tshogs kyi// tshal dang me tog du mas mdzes// chu gtsang sbrang chang rgu 'brum gyi// 'bab chu sna

tshogs rab tu 'bab// sgra snyan bya dang bung bas khengs// rgyan dang gos dang bza' btung rnams// bsams pa tsam gyis 'byung 'gyur zhing*// mdzes pa'i lha mo brgya phrag gis// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sil snyan sgrogs// me long tshal du sngon gyi las// snang 'gyur bde ba dpag tu med// rlung ltar gar 'dod gnas su rgyu// gnas 'dir lus kyi rtsibs logs nas// zhag bdun na skye bde ldan 'gyur// gnyis pa lag na yol thogs kyi// gnas ni pad ma'i nang rgyu dang*// bung ba sgra gnyan sgra la chags// dris dregs dga' dang rlung la spyod// me tog phreng dga' kun du lta// rtag tu dga' dang dri la chags// spyi gtsug thar te rnam pa bcu// der skye rgyu ni srog gcod spangs// sdom ldan khyad par bye brag ni// dkon mchog dad pas phyag byed dang*// snying rje'i sems ldan mchod rten mchod// dad pas rgyal la gdugs phul dang*// mchod rten la ni dri chab phul// tshad dus dge slong rlung yab byin// skom dang ngal la chu phul dang*// nad pa'i rim 'gro byas pa dang*// btson rar gnas pa thar par byed// dkon mchog la ni gos mchog 'bul// gtsug nas bcings pa thar byed pa'o// 'di rnam bde ba snga ma las// shin tu lhag te brdzus skyes ldan// sna tshogs ri bo ljon pa dang*// rin chen las grub 'od stong 'phro// rol mo sgra snyan bya rnams kun// thos pas yid 'phrog ngoms pa med// btung ba sna tshogs 'bab chu rnams// de bzhin bza' ba dpag tu med// kha dog sna tshogs gos rnams kun// yang zhing reg na bde ba yin// sna tshogs spos kyi ngad ldang zhing*// gang 'dod rlung ni kun du ldang*// gzugs mchog rgyan rnams kyis mdzes pa// lha mo rnams dang lhan cig brtse// yul lnga bde ba dpag tu med// phyir zhing sred pa 'phel byed pas// ma tshim srid pa gzhan tu 'pho// de nas gsum pa rtag myos kyi// gnas ni bcu ste dang po ni// lhag dga' zhes bya der skye'i rgyu// lha dang gnod sbyin gnas pa yi// ljon pa mi gcod tshul ldan pa'o// gang gis utpal bskyed byas nas// dad pas phul gang utpal mdog

tshul ldan pad tshal rab 'bul gang*// pad dkar spyod pa'i gnas der skye// chos gos dmar po dad pas 'bul// dmar po spyod pa'i lha gnas skye// tshul ldan bza' btung sbyin byed gang*// sna tshogs gnas skye bde mchog ldan// tsha grang skyob pa'i gnas sbyin pa// de ni mtho bar gnas su skye// tshim byed bza' btung gter ba ni// rgun chang rtag myos der skyes 'gyur// yo byad byin te nad sos pas// dga' de yul la 'dod du skye// snying rjes 'chi khar skom blud pas// chu bsil gnas skye bde bar spyod// bstan dgar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu// dge slong nges 'byung rkyen byas pa'o// gnas 'di rnams ni thams cad tu// gong ma gnyis las bcu 'gyur gyi// bde ldan longs spyod ldan pa yin// mdzes ma'i lha mo myos ma dang*// bya dang bung ba myos pa rnams// glu dang gar byed 'brel ba bzhin// ma dha ra dang rin chen brgyan// bsam gyis mi khyab sil sil sgrogs// 'dod pa'i yon tan drug po yi// khyad par dga' ba rtag tu 'phel// khang bzang bskyed tshal me tog tshogs// nyi ma bzhin du rab tu 'bar// yul gyi khyad par mdzes pa rnams// bsam mi khyab pas myos pa yin// de nas bzhi pa rgyal po bzhi// gnas pa pi wang gsum pa'i gnas// dpag med longs spyod gnyis sred pas// der skye'i rgyu 'bras lhan cig bshad// dang po dri dga' zhes bya bar// skye ba'i rgyu ni dge 'dun la// kun dga' ra ba bskyed tshal phul// de 'bras skyed tshal mtshungs med ldan// snying rjes 'chi khar skom blud pas// log lta bzlog phyir chos ston pa// sgra snyan gnas skye khyad par du// gnas der lha mo sgra nyan cing*// bya dang bung ba mdzes pa yin// skom sbyin 'gron po bde byed gang*// de la chags skye gnas de ni// mtshungs med ljon pa bya rnams dang*// ri bo rnams kyis brgyan pa yin// snying rje che ldan 'chi ba la// sman dang chu ster skyor chu skyes// gnas skye longs spyod dpag med cing*// khyad par dus dran bya rnams yod// lha khang mchod rten skyang nul byed// lus dkar du skyes gnas de ni// tshal rnams kha dog so so ste// rang lus de yi kha dog 'gyur// phan tshun dga' ldan tshul khrims gcod// sbyin las byung ste der skyes pas// sna tshos 'dres pa'i tshal ldan pas// lhag par 'dod pas myos pa yin// yang dag chags spyod der skye ba// las byed khyim pa gzengs bstod nas// dge la sbyar byas lha mos btud// 'dir ni 'phags skyes gnas pa yin// chos ldan sbyin la dad byed pas// 'khor dang rnam spyod gnas su skye// der ni rnam pa du ma yis// yul drug myos par byed pa yod// dkyil krungs bcas skyer mu ge'i dus// sbyin dang chur skyes byin pas skyes// 'dzam bu'i tshal sogs rab dga' bar// 'bod pa zhes bya bya rnams yod// spyod ldan gnas su skye ba'i rgyu// 'thab 'khrol gnod pa thar byed pa'o// gzugs kyis lhag myos me long tshal// rgyal chen mig mi bzang gnas so// yul 'khor skyong ni shar phyogs te// lus ngan byang phyogs lcang lo can// gzhan yang yul pa 'phags par skyes// sna tshogs gzugs dang lcang lo can// ngos la nyis brgya lnga cu pa// gnya' shing 'dzin steng gnas pa ste// dpag med bkod pa longs spyod ldan// de 'khor kun du rgyu ba'i lha// bye ba phrag ni sum cu drug

/de rnams gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang*// gza' skar zhes kyang 'jig rten grags// nyi zla gnyis ni lha gnas te// dpag tshad lnga cu gcig dang bcas// gyen 'thur 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang*// nang na skyed tshal grong khyer dang*// lteng khas brgyan cing longs spyod ldan// 'khor lo'i rlung gis 'dren pa yin// nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang*// nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus cig /nyi ma'i 'od dang rang grib la// brten nas zla ba 'phel 'grib byed// 'dir ni tshul ldan brtse ba can// khyad par sgron me byin pa'i mthu// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po ni// tshul khrims bsod nams gzhan pas lhag /sna tshogs longs spyod bsam mi khyab// sems kyi kun rtog dge ba yin// grangs bzhin yul kyang de 'drar snang*// 'di ltar lha gnas bzhi bcu ru// skyes nas bde ba mang spyad kyang*// de zad ngan 'gror ltung bar byed// 'di rnams tshe ni mi rnams kyi// lnga bcu'i lo la zhag gcig ste// rang lo lnga brgya mi lo ni// sa ya gcig dang 'bum phrag brgyad// mir skyes na ni rgyu mthun gyis// phyug cing skal bzang 'khor mang gtan pa// mchod bcas srog sbyin stong phrag gis// mig stong 'dren par skye bar 'gyur// de ni lha yi dbang phyug ste// bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi// lha mo mdzes ma rnams kyis mchod// de rnams mchog ni bde sogs te// de sogs lha yi rin chen rnams// bla na med la dbang phyed yin// lhun po'i rtse la brgyad khri ste// lta na sdug dbus chos bzang gnas// dpag tshad lnga brgya rin chen gyi// rang bzhin skyed tshal bzhi dang ldan// bud med dga' tshal kun dga'i tshal// dpe med thams cad 'byor pa bzhi// de sogs nye ba'i tshal dang bcas// thams cad sna tshogs ljon pa ni// dpag med rdzing bu du mas brgyan// zla bzang pad chen ma dha ra// rin chen me tog du mar ldan// sgra snyan legs sbyar smra ba yi// bung ba bya rnams du mas gang*// dus dang dus med tshal rnams na// lha yi gos dang rgyan dang zas// kha dog bzhi ldan yid bzhin 'byung*// khang brtsegs mdzes pa dpag med dang*// rin chen bye ma brdal ba dang*// mnyen bkra ched du bshams pa bzhin// nyi zla las lhag 'od ldan pa// sna tshogs gzhon pa du ma dang*// dus 'brang tsan dan sna tshogs dri// dpe byar med pa rnams dang ldan// mnga' bdag ko'u shi ka'i yis// lha rnams legs ston pha dang 'dra// sna tshogs bde ba myong bar byed// de sras chos bzangs lha kun kyang*// lha rnams bde ba dpe med ldan// srog gcod ma byin len spang shing*// sbyin dang gus pas bskyed pa yin*// de na gnyis pa mthor gnas su// skye ba'i rgyu ni gzhan gang dag

/srog gcod ma byin len byed pa// spong la sbyar ba'i gnas de ni// bza' btung chu bo du ma dang*// ljon tshal gyis bsten bde ldan yin// gsum pa ri rtser gnas zhes bya// gsod dang bur shing sogs rku ba// spangs shing gzhan yang der sbyor ba'o// de na skyed tshal drug yod de// yul lnga lha mo du ma dang*// rab myos bde ba dpag tu med// bzhi pa lta na sdug gnas pa'i// lha rnams mtshon dang chu las ni// srog 'don byed dang nyam nga ba'i// ma byin len pa spangs pas skye// dpag tshad khri pa gser rang bzhin// dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i sgo// gnod sbyin kyis bsrungs srang mnyam zhing*// rdzing bu bskyed tshal bzhi mdo rnams// lha mos mdzes byas sil snyan rdung*// g.yer ka mu tig phreng bas mdzes// rin chen shing rtar bzhon cir 'gro /phun tshogs bde bar ldan pa yin// lnga pa phyogs cig gnas skye ba'i// rgyu ni dbul yang sbyin byed dang*// log g.yem bzung ba mthar byed pa'o// de ni 'od dang rgyan rnams kun// gzhan pas lhag 'gyur lha mo rnams// mchod byed bde ldan smad du byung*// drug pa shing bseb gnas pa'i lha// der skye byed rgyu pha ma dang*// rgyal la dad byed rkun po rnams// thar byed gzhan phan ldan cing drang*// der ni ljon tshogs khang bzang dang*// rdzing bu bya bzhin rjes 'breng zhing*// lha mo rnams dang bcas pa rnams// bde ba du ma dpe las 'das// bdun pa shing rta sna tshogs su// sku gzugs mchod rten longs spyod rnams// 'phrog pa tshig 'jam bzlog pas skye// gnas der bya rnams bsod spangs longs spyod dag /ma byin mi len chos ston pa'o// dpag tshad sum stong rin chen gyi// ljon pas gang zhing de rnams las// khang khyim bza' btung longs spyod tshogs// thams cad bsam pa tsam gyis 'byung*// der ni lha'i dbang po yang*// glang po sa srungs sprul byed cing*// dga' spyod byed cing 'gro ba yin// dgu pa rnam mdzes zhes bya'i gnas// der ni srog chags phra mo rnams// mi gsod rdza mkhan sogs kyi rdzas// ma byin len pa spangs pas skye// gser tshal rin chen dra bas dkab// bai ḍūrya yi g.yer ka las// chos sgra tshig bcad snyan pa 'byin// tshal 'dir g.yul 'gyed sngon 'gro ste// pham rgyal gnod pa snang bar mthong*// de phyir tshal 'di 'phags pa yin// bcu pa yong 'dur skye ba'i rgyu// pha la bkur byed sdom ldan pas// kha na ma tho phra mo 'dzem// de yi ljon pa khyad 'phags te// mi rnams chos tshul ldan mi ldan// shes te bde ba du ma yod// der ni lha kun rgyal la mchod// dbyar gyi kun dga' spyod pa yin// bcu gcig 'dres pa'i 'gram gnas pa// srog chags phra mo gsod rgyu spong*// shing yang ma byin mi len pa'o// der skyes bde ba myong 'gyur te// sna tshogs

gzhi bkra mnyen pa'i tshal// du mar lha mo rnams dang brtse// bcu gnyis tshang tshing 'gram gnas te// khrims ldan gzhan yang bsam gtan pa// sbyin byed gnas der skye ba ste// dus kyi tshal du bde spyod sman sbyin pa// me tog khyim dang bya rnams kyis// phye ba'i tshal du lha mos dga'// bco lnga ba ni gser phug gi /khang pa yin te der skye'i rgyu// dgra yang skyob byed sdom ldan zhing*// srog kyang btang ste gzhan phan brtson// rang gi zas kyang sbyin pa'o// brgya byin dga' ba'i gser gnas der// dga' tshal kun las khyad 'phags yod// sngon ni nga las nu yi sa spyad// 'phreng ba'i grib ma bcu drug pa// dung dang chu srin nya rnams kyi// srog mi gcod cing dkon mchog gi /spos kyang bdag gir mi byed pa'o// der ni rin chen grib shing kun// mchog tu bzang ldan gzhal med dang*// rdzing bu du ma me tog bkra// rin chen bya dang bung bas gang*// de las gzhan yang bcu bdun pa// mtho dman rgyu zhes bya ba der// skye ba'i rgyu ni sbrul la sogs// mi gsod ma byin len spangs mthus// lha mo rnams dang bya tshogs dang*// bung ba dang bcas ri dang tshal// kun du 'dod pa'i yon tan ldan// spyod kyang tshim pa med pa yin// sna tshogs bkra bas phye ba yin// bco brgyad pa ste der skye ba// srog skyob drang zhing g.yo sgyu bral// gzhan phan byed ldan yid rang ba'o// de ni yul lnga mtshungs med pa// thob nas chags 'gyur lha mo dang*// lhan cig yid 'ong tshal du brtse// bag med gyis bcom srid gzhan 'gro// sbyor ba 'jug pa zhes bya'i gnas// bcu dgu pa'o der skye'i rgyu// srog gcod ma byin len pa yi// rnam pa kun spong sbyin ldan pa'o// ka ra bi ra'i tshal mdzes yod// gnas kun lta byed longs spyod rnams// thob cing bde bas tshim pa med// nyi zla'i gnas kyang lta bar byed// nyi shu pa ni zhib spyod de// der ni drang zhing bzang por spyod// phra mo'i srog la'ang mi 'tshe dang*// khe dang gzhan gnod spangs pas skye// dpag tshad nyi shu phyed bcas pa'i// sna tshogs tshal dang spos brtsegs ri// mu tig 'phreng ldan 'bab chur ldan// der gnas lha'i dbang po dgyes// glu sgra shin du chags pa'i 'phags myos 'gro 'dul// zhes bya'i khang bzang phul byung ba// bcom ldan 'khor ba 'jig bzhugs yod// de na bya rnams sgra 'byin pa// ji ltar pad ma'i tshal nang du// rjen za bya rgod mdzes ma yin// de bzhin zhi ba'i dgon pa ru// mi dge spyod pa mi mdzes so// ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od grang na// log par gyur te mi mthun ltar// bag med lha rnams ga la zhig /zhi ba'i tshal du ga la dga'// sred dang bral ba'i bde ba dang*// sdug bsngal grol ba'i skyob pa gang*// bde ba de yi khyad par las// bde 'di grangs su mi brtsi'o// rab tu myos med bsam gtan pa// kun du zhags las grol ba yi// bde ba de ni bde mchog ste// sred pas bslus pa 'di ma yin// tshal 'di thub pas brten pa ste// shin du bsgom pa rnams kyis brten// lha mchog 'dod chags yid byed kye// bsten par 'os pa ma yin no// zhes sogs du ma sgrogs pa yod// gzhal med khang chen mdzes pa de'i// logs la rgyal bas tshigs bcad bris// g.yang sar lhung ba'i gang zag ni// gal te 'tsho bar 'gyur yang srid// bag med par ni ltung ba dag /nam kyang bde ba mi 'thob bo// gal te las rnams thams cad la// gang zag shin du bag med pa// de ni nyin dang mtshan dag tu// nam kyang dge bar mi 'gyur ro// 'jig rten cung zad bde gang dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba gang*// de dag bag med pa yis 'jig /de bas de ni yongs su spongs// zhes sogs lha kun don mdzad do// 'di ni de bas rmad du byung*// nyi shu gnyis pa gzi brjid 'bar// der ni sngon bzhin sdom ldan zhing*// pha ma dkon mchog mchod pas skye// gser ri chu rnams lhung lhung sgrogs// lha mo gar byed yid g.yo ba// pad tshal dpag tshad lnga brgya pa// bya rnams chos sgra sgrogs pa yod// bde ba du ma steng ma rdzing na rdzing mchog yod// lha kun bag med bzlog pa'i phyir// sngon ni rgyal ba 'od srung gis// gcig tu las kyi me long sprul// lha rnams mchog dang bar mtha' yi// las kun mthong bar byin longs spyod ldan pa dang*// chos kyi rjes su mthun par 'gyur// 'dir ni mi lo brgyad brgya la// zhag yin des bsgres rang lo ni// stong phrag brgyad yin mi lo'i grangs// bye ba nyis brgya sum cu dang*// nyams pa'o// de bzhin rnam dag sbyin pa ni// yul lnga mchog tu gyur pa la// gus bcas sbyor dngos rjes gsum ldan// 'on kyang de na rigs gnyis te// bdud rigs gtogs dang gzhan ma'o// de yang phal dang 'phags rigs gnyis// dang po sngon ni log lta dang*// 'brel pa'i smon lam gyis 'byung ste// dper na shor ba gzhon nu yis// rgya ba 'od zhi spos snang gis// bstan la ma dad gang byas pa// dge sbyong chen po ud dpal gdong*// snying rjes bskul bas don byas pa'i// mthu yis 'di na bdud ces grags// 'on kyang rgyu 'di bstan med pa// mchod sbyin gyis bsgrubs 'bras bus yin// log ltas mnar med 'khrid pa yin// de bas rgyu 'bras so sor smin// gzhan dag yang dag lta dang ldan// log lta ring du spangs pa yin// gnas 'di 'dod pa'i lha mi rnams// kun gyi gnas la khyad 'phags te// gzhan gyis 'phrul la dbang byed phyir// nyi ma dang ni me khyer bzhin// phyogs cig nye bar brjod pa na// dbang sgyur lha yi gzhal med khang*// dpag tshad brgya stong du mar ldan// gru bzhi rin chen bzhi rang bzhin// gzhi ni rin chen bai ḍūrya// sna tshogs sgo dang sgo khyud dang*// skar khung rta babs du ma rnams// rin chen du ma spel ba la// 'od zer nyi ma las lhag 'phro// ka ba stong phrag du ma rnams// cig ni gser la de bzhin dngul// bai ḍūrya dang shel dang ni// mar gad pad ma ra ga dang*// spug dang rdo yi snying po dang*// re re'ang bsam gyis mi khyab bo// 'dod na mkha' la bya bzhin 'gro// 'di na skyed mo tshal mchog rnams// re re ngag gis brjod mi nus// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi// mda' lnga yul la dbang byed cing*// gnas 'dir sred pa bskyed byed na// su zhig mya ngan 'da' bar nus// de phyir dbang bsgyur bdud kyi yul// 'dod khams kun las phul byung yin// dga' bzang la sogs lha mo rnams// bye ba brgya phrag du mas gang*// gcig gi 'od dang gzugs dang brgyan// sna tshogs gos ldan sgrib med pa// mdzes pa spyod tshul sgyu ma bzhin// bsams kyang shes par mi 'gyur ba// chags bral ma rtogs 'jig rten 'dir// g.yo bar mi 'gyur su zhig yod// mthong ba tsam gyis tshim byed 'gyur// gnas de rol mo gcig gis brgyan// lha gnas sgra kun zil gnon na// mi rnams rol mo smos ci dgos// de yi bdud rtsi ro myongs na// gzhan dag lha yi zhal zas kun// bong pa'i ro dang mtshungs par 'gyur// yang dang tsha grang reg pa yis// ma gdung lus kun tshim byed pa// sgrib med gos mchog phul du byung*// de yi dri bsung cig gis kyang*// phyogs kun dang bar byed par 'gyur// lha mi'i bdug spos zil gnon byed// de ltar brjod kyis mi lang ba'i// khyad par bsam par nus pa ni// de na me tog re re yang*// dpag tshad du ma'i khyon ldan pa// 'dab ma stong phrag du mas mdzes// dbang po'i gzhu la phul byung ba'i// 'od kyi dra ba mdzes pa yin// khor yug mtshungs med dri ldang ba// ro brgya ldan pa'i btung ba dang*// ldan pa de la 'dug byed na// 'dod na mkha' la 'gro bar byed// 'dod na sna tshogs g.yer kha yi// sgra dang mu tig rgyan 'phreng rnams// kun du khyab byed sprin phung 'dra// de sogs mthu ni dpag med ldan// ljon pa ri dang 'bab chu dang*// sa phyogs dga' tshal khyad par rnams// 'phags min skye bos brjod mi lang*// mdor na sems kyi kun rtog la// snang ba'i 'dod ldan gyis bsgrubs pa// gnas 'di las ni lhag yod min// de 'dra'i 'bras bu phul byung la// spyod pa gang de bdud ces pa// byis pa'i skye bo 'khrul pa rnams// mi rnams longs spyod cung zad tsam// myong yang sred pas ro myong zhing*// bag med brgyags pas rab myos na// de la myos nas zhi ba yi// bde ba las ni phyir phyogs 'gyur// gang tshe bag med la brten nas// sred dang myos dang 'thab pa dang*// yid 'khrug 'gyur ba smos ci dgos// de ni bdud kyi pho nya bzhi// de rnams dbang bsgyur mi dge spyod// 'bras bu sngon bshad ngan 'gror ltung*// des na bdud kyi lha zhes spyod// de ltar snang ba'i longs spyod kyang*// rmi lam ltar shes bag yod cing*// 'dod khams dbang byed nga rgyal dang*// rlom pas sgrib par mi nus par// ma chags bsam gtan spyod pa gang*// 'dod pa'i khams las 'da' bas na// bdud dbang ma gyur lha zhes bya// de phyir bstan la zhugs pa rnams// sbyin dang tshul khrims dag pa la// spyad cing ma chags spyod pa dang*// rang gi don tsam mi sems par// bzod dang brtson 'grus rab ldan pas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// bsam gtan gnas la 'dun par bya// 'dir ni mi lo stong drug brgya// zhag cig yin te des bsgres pa// khri dang drug stong rang lo thub// mi ltar brtsis na bye ba ni// dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig ni// sa ya drug ste 'di dag rnams// kun la dus min 'chi ba yod// de ltar 'dod la rigs drug gi

/nyin mtshan me tog bye zum dang*// gnyid dang bya skad 'byin mi 'byin// yin te mun pa yod ma yin// lus tshad rgyang grags bzhi cha nas// phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du yin// mdor na 'dod pa'i khams 'di na// srog gcod spangs pa tshe ring la// bzod byas gzugs mchog phun sum tshogs// ma byin len spangs bdag nyid kyi// longs spyod srungs pa'i mchog yin no// gzhan gnod 'dod spyod rab spangs pas// mtshungs med khyim thab lha mo ldan// brdzun spangs bden pa thob 'gyur te// phra ma spangs pa mi phyed 'thob// ngag 'khyal spangs pas ngag btsun 'gyur// tshig rtsub spangs na snyan smra la// srog byin gzhan gyis 'tshe ba med// nor byin longs spyod du ma 'byung*// sman byin nad med thob pa ste// bza' btung sbyin pas bkres skom med// bzhon pa lham sbyin de nyid dang*// ngal ba med dang mgyogs par 'gyur// sil snyan byin pas sgra snyan 'gyur// sgron me byin pas 'od thob 'gyur// rgyan dang me tog 'phreng mdzes byin// de nyid dang ni mdzes pa thob// gru zam gyis ni bde brlag 'gro// ngal stegs byas pa ngal med 'gyur// khang pa byin pas rin chen gyis// brgyan pa'i khang bzang thob par 'gyur// skyed tshal sa gzhi byin pa las// thams cad pa yi bdag por 'gyur// bran dang 'khor byin de nyid dang*// gang gang byin pa'i 'bras bur ldan// rgyal dang dam chos dge 'dun dang*// pha ma nad pa dbul po dang*// ma rnyed 'dod pa rim ci bzhin// sbyin zhing mchog dang sman pa yin// dbang med khyim sogs ched du ni// ma dag 'byung ba rnams la ni// bsreg dang chu sogs 'bras bza' min// dngos po khyad par de bzhin te// sdig dang ma 'dres mchog tu 'gyur// dug mtshon chu sogs ma dag yin// 'di dang phyi ma rang gzhan gyi// don sems dman dang 'bring po ste// mya ngan 'das thob 'dod pa gang*// bla med de yang mchog dman gnyis// mdor na sbyin dang tshul khrims kyi// gnas la bzod brtson bsod nams tshogs// rgyu 'di spangs nas gti mug gi

/'phangs te chags dang zhe sdang pas// sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar byed// de phyir bde ba 'dod gang ste// sgrims te rgyu 'bras brtag par bya// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ //de nas gzugs khams bshad par bya// dug gsum kun ldang drag po yi// chags bral de las gong mar brjod// de yang rnam gnyis 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das 'brel rnam pa can// de'ang bsam gtan nyer sdogs las// byung ba gnas gzhan bcu gnyis te// tshangs rigs tshangs pa 'du na 'don// tshangs chen 'od chung tshad med 'od// 'od gsal dge chung tshad med dge /dge rgyas sprin med bsod nams skyes// 'bras bu che ste gzhan ma lnga// mi che mi gdung gya nom snang*// shin du mthong dang 'og min pa// de rnams 'phags pa'i lha yin no// gang gis bsam gtan dang po ni// sgom byed sbyin dang tshul khrims ni// sngar ltar dag pa legs spyod pa// de tshe 'dod pa'i bde ba nyams// chags zhen sred pa'i rgyur mthong nas// de spong byed de bsam gtan la// sred cing len pas mtshams sbyar te// tshangs ris nyid skye de bas kyang*// mi lcogs med bsgom gnyis pa ste// dag pa byams dang 'brel bsgom pa// tshangs chen du skye de dag kyang*// phal pa bsgom pa nyon mongs ldan// don rab 'byed ldan de gcod pas// khyad 'phags yang dag lam du 'gro// de rnams gnas ni bsod nams mthus// yul du snang ba khyad 'phags te// sna tshogs rin chen zhing du snang*// mthon dman sdong dum yod min te// mnyam zhing yid bzhin ldan pa yin// tshangs pa'i gzhal med grub pa gang// 'dod khams rin chen kun gyis kyang*// de yi cha shas ri ba min// de yi 'od zer cha cig kyang*// dbang bsgyur 'od kyang mog mog byed// tshangs gnas sil snyan gcig gi sgra// thos na 'dod khams sems can sgra// zil gnon dus byed 'gyur zhes grag

/de sogs yul gyi longs spyod rnams// dpag tu med kyang 'dod pa med// de na pho mo med pa ste// gnas 'di nas ni 'og min par// gang tshe skyes pa de yi tshe// kun rdzogs gos dang bcas pa nyid// gnyid dang nyin mtshan med pa ste// bsam gtan zas mchog dga' dang ldan// rang rang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ste// 'dod khams snying rje'i gnas su mthong*// tshul 'di rnams ni bcu drug 'gyur// gong ma gong ma 'phags zhes grag /de rnams mchog ni mi mched kyi// tshangs pa chen po zhes grags te// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// dam chos bskul 'di 'phags pa yin// gzhan dag log lta'i gzhir gyur pa// blo nyams rnams kyis smra bar byed// de ltar bsam gtan dang po las// grub pa gsum yin de las gzhan// gnyis pa rtog med bsgoms pa las// 'od chung du skye sngar bas lhag /de nyid mi lcogs med bsgom pa// tshad med 'od skye de las gzhan// phul du byung ba 'od gsal yin// 'di rnams gnas ni tshangs chen las// gong ma gong ma'i khyad par du// 'phags pa'i snang ldan zhi ba yin// shin du dga' dang bde ba yi// lus sems tshim byed bla na med// de nas dga' bde dang bral zhing*// dran rig g.yo ba rlung rgyu ba// tsam ldan bsam gtan gsum pa ni// bsgoms las dge chung du skye la// bstan byas tshad med dge yin te// shin du bstan pas dge rgyas zhes// dge bas gang bas grub par 'gyur// rang snang 'od kyi gzhal yas khang*// mtshungs med rab tu zhi bar snang*// zhing dang bde ba ci snyed pa// 'jig rten dpe byar gang yang med// 'on kyang rang rang bsam gtan mthus// gong ma gong ma rim pas 'phags// gzhan yang bsam gtan bzhi pa ni// g.yo med zhes bya de bsgoms pas// sprin med zhes bya de 'gro ste// de goms bsod nams skyes su skyes// mthar thug gyur pa 'bras bu che// de rnams rab tu zhi ba'i lha// khyad par 'phags par bshad pa yin// der ni zag bcas mthus bskyed phyir// re zhig nyon mongs zhir snang yang*// 'jig rten sems can kun rtog 'di// ro myang 'dzin dang rab 'brel pas// thal ba bkab pa'i me bzhin du// yun ring lon kyang tshul min kyi// yid byed kyis bskyed las nyon mongs// shing dang phrad nas 'bar bar 'gyur// de bas don rab 'byed pa yi// shes rab kyis bzung bsam gtan ni// 'phags pa'i lam 'brel bsgom par bya// de gnyis khyad par bshad bya ba// snga ma chos kun ma rtogs kyang*// sems gnas khyad par las byung ngo*// phyi ma chos kun rten 'brel kyi// tshul shes sems dang sems 'byung gi

/rnam pa rgyu dang 'bras mthong nas// rtog dang spyod pa gnyis po ste// de la rtse gcig brtson byas pas// dga' bde 'bras bu rab tu skye// de ni bsam gtan dang po yin// rtogs spyod dang bral rtse cig par// nang du rab tu dang ba yi// dga' bde ldan pa gnyis pa yin// rtogs spyod bde sdug dang bral zhing*// dran dang shes bzhin ldan rtse cig /bsam gtan gsum pa zhes byar bshad// rtogs spyod bde dang sdug bsngal dang*// yid bde mi bde dbyugs dbyung rngub// skyon brgyad med cing mi g.yo ba// btang snyoms dran pa dag pa ni// bsam gtan bzhi pa zhes bya'o// tshul 'di de bzhin nyid 'brel pas// 'phags pa'i bsam gtan zhes brjod do// nyon mongs can la dga' bde dang*// rab dang shes bzhin dran pa dang*// btang snyoms dran pa dag med de// nyon mongs dben pa min phyir dang*// nyon mongs snyog pas dang min dang*// nyon mongs can de dran shes med// dran dag min te drir bcas phyir// 'di dag ldog pa'i bsam gtan yin// 'di yi bsam gtan bzhi pa las// 'du shes bkag nas de tsam gyis// mya ngan 'das par rtog byed pa// 'du shes med pa'i lha zhes pa// grong las dgon pa'i tshul skyes yod// de ni phyir zhing log lta yis// 'tshams sbyar mnar med lhung byed pas// mi khom gnas yin tshe ring lha// de phyir tshul ldan bsam gtan pa// shes rab rnam par sbyang bar bya// mi che la sogs lnga rnams ni// bsam gtan shes rab dang 'brel pas// nyon mongs che min des mi gdung*// nyon mongs bral ba'i yon tan ni// gya nom snang dang 'og min 'gro// rgyu des 'phags pa zhes bya'i lha// dag pa'i zhing bzhin rang snang ngo*// de rnams gtso bo lha yi bu// dbang phyug chen po zhes bya'o// de ltar gzugs khams bcu bdun ni// sbyin sogs kyis bskyed lha yin te// zag bcas zag pa bral ba las// 'dus byas mngon par grub par bshad// de rnams lus kyi tshad bshad pa// tshangs ris dpag tshad phyed yin te// gcig dang phyed dang gnyis rim bzhin// de yi gong ma'o 'od chung gnyis// tshad med 'od dang 'od gsal ni// dpag tshad bzhi dang brgyad yin no// dge chung sogs gsum bcu drug dang*// so gnyis re bzhi rim pa bzhin// sprin med brgyad dang nyer lnga'o// bsod nams skyes nas 'og min bar// phyed dang sum brgya lnga brgya dang*// stong dang gnyis stong stong phrag bzhi// brgyad stong de bzhin khri drug stong*// tshad tshe tshangs ris skal chung ni// nyi shu de bzhin bzhi bcu ste// tshangs chen lnga bcu nga brgyad 'dod// 'od chung nas bzung bskal chen gnyis// gzhan ni dpag tshad grangs dang mnyam// lha gnas rnams kyi tha gru'i tshad// gling bzhi de bzhin spyi phud dang*// stong gnyis gsum pa rim ci bzhin// 'dod gzugs gtsang ma man chad yin// de ltar gnas dang gzhan snang ba// lus can bsam pa ci ltar bzhin// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las// gzugs kyi khams kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o//

༈ //de las gzhan pa gzugs med ni// rgyu dang ngo bo tshe tshad rnams// rim bzhin gsal bar bshad par bya// gang zhig skye 'phags gang yin kyang*// bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas// gzugs ni rags bcas ma zhi bar// mthong nas gzugs kyi 'du shes te// dgag phyir mkha' ltar dmigs pa gang*// nam mkha' mtha' yas zhes bya ste// rnam par shes dang 'du byed kyi// khyad par ma brten de 'thob po// dang po gzugs sgra reg bya chos// nyer rtogs yin ste gzhan mar gsum// chos la dmigs pa kho nas bskyed// rnam shes mtha' yas nyid bsgom pa// gong ma las kyang zhi bar 'dod// rnam shes nyid kyang rags mthong nas// rtog de bshig pa ci yang med// yul la mtshan ma 'dzin pa yi// ci yang med rtog yin mthong nas// de bshig yod min med min te// bstan pa'i rnam par shes pa dang*// nyon mongs can yid gnas pa nyid// gang gang goms pa la brten nas// gang du shi ba der de 'thob// ngo bo rnam shes de nyid du// nyer dmigs zhi ba'i nga rgyal tsam// der ni bskal pa nyi khri dang*// bzhi khri drug khri brgyad khri rnams// tshe'i tshad do 'di dag rnams// 'dod gzugs 'das pas zhi yin kyang*// shes rab bral nas 'og tu ltung*// de bas mkhas pa bsam gtan pa// khams gsum la sred su zhig byed// theg mchog zhugs pa'i snying rje can// 'di dag ting 'dzin thob nas kyang*// ro myang ma yin der mi skye// 'dod dang gzugs kyi chags bral kyang*// bsams bzhin gzhan la phan par byed// gang gis sems kyis dri ma dang*// 'du byed las dang nyon mongs rnams// ma rtogs dge dang mi dge ba// thog med dus nas rjes zhugs pas// zo chu bzhin du khams gsum 'khor// de mthong khams gsum srid bde la// ma zhen zhen par 'gyur rnams la// tshad med rnam bzhi bskyed par bya// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa las// gzugs med pa'i khams kyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o//

༈ //de ltar khams gsum sems can gyi// yul du snang ba'i rnam shes la// thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i// gnas su snang ba bshad par bya// 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni// rngams su sa ya drug 'bum ste// rgyar ni grangs su ma brjod pa// brtan par chags shing de yi steng*// chu rngams 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang*// stong phrag nyi shu de las phyis// 'bum phrag brgyad de lhag ma ni// sum 'bum nyi khri gser yin no// thad kar 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang*// sum stong phyed dang lnga brgya'o// khor yug tu ni sum 'gyur yin// steng du tshangs gnas sprin las ni// char rgyun las chu de la ni// rlung gis bsrubs pas tshangs gnas nas// ri gling bar du rim pas byung*// lhag ma rol mtsho ba tsha can// nang gi mtshor gyur de rnams kyang*// gling rnams rngams su brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong lhun po gnyis 'gyur ro// sa nas ri bdun khor yug bcas// lhun po nas ni rim pa bzhin// phyed phyed kyis dma' rngams kyang mnyam// rol mtsho nang ma brgyad khri'i zheng*// gzhan rnams phyed phyed kyis phri'o// ba tsha'i rgya mtsho khor yug bar// sum 'bum nyis khri nyis stong yin// 'dzam gling ngos gsum nyis stong ste// gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi// lus 'phags sum brgya lnga bcu ste// nub phyogs stong phrag phyed dang brgya// sgra mi snyan ni stong phrag brgyad// zur gsum zla gam zlum po dang*// gru bzhi'i dbyibs su gnas pa yin// de ltar bskal chung gcig tu chags// 'dzam gling ma dros mtsho yi 'og /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na// mnar med de dag dmyal ba bdun// gnas zhes 'dir bshad gzhan dag nas// rlung nas gser gyi bar du bshad// gzhan ni sngar bshad rim pa ltar// rang rang rtog pa'i dbang gis byung*// lhun po rin chen bzhi rang bzhin// ri bdun gser yin khor yug lcags// gling bzhi phran bcas sa yin te// sna tshogs bstan pa ltar snang dang*// de brtan bstan min me dang rlung*// char sprin rtsa shing me tog sogs// sna tshogs 'byung ba rnam bzhi dang*// dus kyis rkyen snang nam mkha' yis// go phye skye 'gag ltar snang ba// sa chus 'phel byed rlung gis bsgrubs// mes ni smin byas rdul phran tshul// kha dog dbyibs su snang ba yang*// dkar po chu la dmar po me// ser po sa la sngo ba rlung*// kun 'dus ye shes rang bzhin can// zlum po zur gsum gru bzhi dang*// zla phyed thams cad mthun par snang*// rtsol bcas rtsol ba med snang ba// mig dbang spyod yul gyur pa rnams// de bzhin sgra yi khyad par yang*// 'jam dang drag po brtan sgra dang*// g.yo zhing 'ur bcas khams bzhi ste// gsal dag 'byed pa nam mkha'i dngos// dri dang ro rnams rim ji bzhin// sa chu me rlung stong pa las// lan tsha mngar dang tsha kha ska// skyur ba mkha' ste ye shes brjod// reg bya sra 'jam rtsub dang yang*// khams bzhi gsal byed mkha'i rang bzhin// mthun snang thun mong rig byed yin// chu la lha rnams bdud rtsi dang*// yi dwags khrag dang dmyal ba rnams// zangs zhun sogs snang des mthun sogs// rmi lam yul bzhin tha dad du// thun mong ma yin rig byed 'dod// mdor na yul du snang ba yi// rig pa las ni gzhan ma yin// de bzhin ming gzhi la brten pa// rab tu byed par bshad pa bzhin// de dag bskal chung nyi shu'i bar// chags par snang zhing gang gi tshe// mnar med grub nas gnas pa ste// mi tshe dpag med dus nas ni// tshe lo bcu yi mthar thug bar// ya thog zhes bya de nas ni// brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel 'grib pa// bar gyi bskal pa bco brgyad dang*// mthar ni 'phel nas ma tho cig

/de rnams nyi shur gnas pa ste// brgya brgyar 'phel dang 'grib ces grags// yang ni bcud rnams rim pa ltar// 'jig rten dmyal nas rim pa bzhin// gong du 'pho dang 'jig rten gzhan// 'pho byed mi dang lha rnams ni// bsam gtan rang mtshan nyid brten nas// sems can med nas bcud zad do// de nas nyi ma rab tsha bas// rtsa shing 'bab chu chu bo bzhi// ma dros rgyas mtsho ba tsha can// lhun po rir bcas bdun pa yis// 'bar byas tshangs gnas bar du bsreg de ltar me yis bsregs pa nas// bskal chung cig ste nyi shur 'jig /zhig nas stongs par de snyed 'dug /de ni bskal pa chen po yin// me yis bdun ste chu yis cig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas kyang*// 'jug tu rlung gis 'jig pa yin// bsam gtan gnyis dang gsum pa'i bar// rtogs spyod dga' bde rlung rgyu ba'i// skyon dang mthun cing rim ci bzhin// gzhan nas sems can skyo skyed dang*// drang phyir rgyal sras mthu ru bzhed// de bzhin bsam gtan bzhi pa nas// g.yo ba med kyang sems can de// 'byung dang 'jig bzhin zhi yang snang*// de bzhin zhing 'dir 'dod khams su// skye dang 'gag par cig mod kyang*// zhen pa'i dbang gis de ltar gsungs// don las phyi rol don bden pa// rdul phran tsam yang yod ma min// sems kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i phyir// stong gsum thun
